title: Gemini 1.5
before: Long context in production meant 100K to 200K tokens.
problem: Codebases, film and long archives still did not fit, so everything needed chunking.
breakthrough: A sparse MoE model with a one-million-token context, retrieving accurately across the whole window.
why: It changed what people thought context length could be, and reopened the retrieval-versus-context argument.
next: Gemini 2.0 and 2.5; long context became a standard competitive axis.
inherits: Million-token context as an available option.
